description: Least-privilege capability set for the Cloud WAN Policy Visualizer. Grants ONLY: (1) the native file-open dialog, and (2) reading the text of a file the user explicitly picked in that dialog. No shell, no network/http, no filesystem WRITE, no directory scopes, no other plugin.

permissions.//: Open the native macOS file-open panel. This does not, by itself, grant any filesystem access -- it only returns the path the user chose.

Read the TEXT of the file the user just selected. Scoped to $FILE, the sentinel for a path returned by the dialog: it does NOT grant reading arbitrary paths, only the one the user actively picked. No write permission is present anywhere in this file.
